;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian civil war|Syrian Civil War]], [[Northwestern Syria offensive (2019–2020)|Northwestern Syria offensive (December 2019–March 2020)]], [[Turkish involvement in the Syrian civil war|Turkish involvement in the Syrian Civil War]]
**Turkey launches an operation in [[Syria]]'s [[Idlib Governorate]] codenamed [[Operation Spring Shield]]. [https://www.dailysabah.com/politics/turkey-launches-operation-spring-shield-in-syrias-idlib/news (''Daily Sabah'')]
**Two [[Syrian Air Force]] [[Sukhoi Su-24|Su-24]] jet aircraft are shot down by [[Turkish Air Force]] [[General Dynamics F-16 Fighting Falcon|F-16]]s using [[air-to-air missile]]s over the [[Syria–Turkey border]], while a Turkish drone is shot down by Syrian government forces in Idlib. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-security-turkey/turkey-strikes-syrian-planes-and-airports-escalating-idlib-fight-idUSKBN20O1KN (Reuters)] [http://www.syriahr.com/?p=366361 (SOHR)] [http://www.syriahr.com/?p=366370 (SOHR)]
**Syrian [[state media]] says the [[Syrian Air Defense Force]] has downed three Turkish [[Unmanned combat aerial vehicle|drones]] used to hit [[Syrian Army]] and air bases. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-security-drones/syrian-army-has-downed-three-turkish-drones-over-idlib-province-state-media-idUSKBN20O1ZD (Reuters)]
**Turkish [[Drone strike|drone]] and [[artillery]] strikes target [[Aleppo International Airport]]. [http://www.syriahr.com/?p=366494 (SOHR)]
**Turkish drone strikes target the [[Hama Military Airport]]. [http://www.syriahr.com/?p=366370 (SOHR)]
**Turkish drone strikes kill 19 Syrian Government troops in the past 24 hours, raising the total killed by Turkey in the past 3 days to 93 Syrian Government troops and 14 [[Hezbollah]] fighters. [http://www.syriahr.com/?p=366529 (SOHR)]
**The Syrian Army launches an operation in the southern city of [[Al-Sanamayn]], [[Daraa Governorate]], after "armed militants" attempted to take over the majority-[[Sunni Islam|Sunni]] city. The operation is reportedly still ongoing as gunmen still hold western parts of the city. [https://www.almasdarnews.com/article/syrian-army-launches-new-anti-terror-operation-in-daraa/ (''Al-Masdar News'')]
*[[Afghan peace process]]
**[[President of Afghanistan|Afghan president]] [[Ashraf Ghani]] rejects a clause in the [[Afghan peace process#2020 agreement|U.S.–Taliban deal]] setting the release of Taliban prisoners ahead of intra-Afghan talks scheduled for March 10. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-51695370 (BBC News)]

****[[San Marino]] reports its first death. [https://www.corriereromagna.it/coronavirus-morto-rimini-paziente-san-marino/ (''Corriere Romagna'')]

***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]

;International relations
*[[European migrant crisis]], [[Northwestern Syria offensive (December 2019–present)]]
**Turkish [[Ministry of the Interior (Turkey)|Interior Minister]] [[Süleyman Soylu]] says 76,358 migrants have left Turkey from [[Edirne Province]] as of this morning towards [[Europe]]. [https://www.aksam.com.tr/guncel/bakan-soylu-saat-0955-itibariyla-edirne-uzerinden-ulkemizden-ayrilan-gocmen-sayisi-3b-76358/haber-1049340 (''Akşam'')]
**[[Greece]] deploys its [[Hellenic Armed Forces|military]] on the border with [[Turkey]] to prevent thousands of migrants from entering the [[European Union]], and suspends all asylum applications for a month while also vowing to [[Deportation|deport]] any migrants who enter Greek territory illegally. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/03/01/world/europe/greece-migrants-border-turkey.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Foreign relations of Syria]]
**[[Syria]] and [[Libya]]'s [[House of Representatives (Libya)|Tobruk-based government]] led by [[Aguila Saleh Issa]] agree to establish diplomatic relations following a high level visit to [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates (Syria)|Syrian Foreign Minister]] [[Walid Muallem]]. Both governments agree to counter "Turkish aggression" in the [[Arab world|region]]. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2020-03/02/c_138833278.htm (Xinhuanet)]

;Politics and elections

**[[Muhyiddin Yassin]] is sworn in as the [[Prime Minister of Malaysia|Prime Minister]] of [[Malaysia]], succeeding [[Mahathir Mohamad]]. ([https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/malaysia-muhyiddin-yassin-swearing-in-prime-minister-12485960 CNA])
*[[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries]]
**Former [[South Bend, Indiana|South Bend]], [[Indiana]] mayor [[Pete Buttigieg]] suspends his [[Pete Buttigieg 2020 presidential campaign|presidential campaign]]. [https://www.nytimes.com./2020/03/01/us/politics/pete-buttigieg-drops-out.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[2020 Tajik parliamentary election]]
**[[Elections in Tajikistan|Parliamentary elections]] are held in [[Tajikistan]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2020/03/01/business/ap-as-tajikistan-election.html (''The New York Times'')] 
*[[Luis Lacalle Pou]] is sworn in as the new [[President of Uruguay]] and succeeds leftist [[Tabaré Vázquez]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/03/uruguay-ushers-conservative-government-15-years-200301183201001.html (Al Jazeera)]
